mobile implementation/smoke coverage exists; real-device restart/return still required

device_procedure: Use a physical Android device with a test account and notification permission initially unset.
Authenticate, complete profile and verify personalized Radar values are truthful before enabling notifications.
Enable notifications and record OS permission result; denial must not be represented as push enabled.
Create/obtain one unread high-match alert for the same tenant and prove another tenant cannot receive/read it.
Background the app, deliver the alert, tap it, return to the app and verify refreshed current opportunity truth.
Force-stop/restart the app and verify authenticated session/cache behavior does not convert unavailable data to zero or current truth.
Record exact app build, API deployment SHA, device/OS, account, alert event id and screenshots/log evidence.
